signal.title: Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super
signal.summary: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。

editorial.intro: 这项研究围绕视觉—语言—动作模型展开，关注机器人如何把视觉观察和语言指令，持续转换成跨时间的动作，而不是只对当前画面做一次反应。
editorial.why_it_matters: VLA 的记忆、推理和实时执行能力，直接决定具身智能能否从演示动作走向长时任务和真实部署。
editorial.watch_next: 继续核对实验是否覆盖真实机器人、长时任务和跨场景泛化。

evidence.excerpt: Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super | NVIDIA Technical Blog DEVELOPER Home Blog Forums Docs Downloads Training Join Technical Blog Subscribe Related Resources Robotics English 中文 Generate Trajectories, Reasoning Traces, and Auto-Labels with NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super Aug 04, 2026 By Boris Ivanovic and Marco Pavone Like Discuss (0) L T F R E AI-Generated Summary Like Dislike NVIDIA Alpamayo 2 Super is a 34-billion-parameter open reasoning vision-language-action model, combining the 32B Cosmos 3 Super Reasoner and a 2B Action Expert, post-trained with reinforcement learning to provide unified trajectory generation, reasoning, meta-action prediction, VQA with 2D grounding, and auto-labeling for AV workflows. The model supports 360-degree perception from up to seven cameras and outputs future trajectories, Chain-of-Causation reasoning traces, high-level meta-actions, grounded scene answers, and structured reasoning auto-labels, facilitating common foundation model use across offline policy teaching, evaluation, data curation, and task customization.
